title: Inspect native pandas data when validating Narwhals DataFrames
answers: Why does check_array fail on a Narwhals DataFrame?
How should check_array inspect pandas-backed Narwhals input?
How should sparse pandas columns behave when wrapped in Narwhals?
body:
Symptom: check_array errors when input is already a Narwhals DataFrame backed by pandas.
Root cause: sklearn/utils/validation.py:check_array accessed pandas-specific dtype and sparse interfaces on the input, which may be a Narwhals wrapper.
Fix pattern: Obtain the native pandas DataFrame with array_df.to_native(); use it for dtype inspection, sparse-column detection, and fully sparse conversion through sparse.to_coo().
Constraints: This pattern applies to pandas-backed DataFrames. Fully sparse DataFrames must enter sparse validation and honor accept_sparse; DataFrames with only some sparse columns warn that conversion will produce a dense NumPy array. Do not generalize pandas-specific inspection to other backends.
applies: check_array handling of native pandas DataFrames and pandas-backed Narwhals DataFrames, especially sparse columns.
